mapper.sql: p.id, p.binding_id, ans.answer_id, p.student_id, u.nick_name AS student_name, u.user_name AS student_user_name, s.student_no, p.dept_id, p.entry_year, p.class_code, p.current_page, p.is_submitted, ans.status AS answer_status, ans.auto_score, ans.manual_adjustment, ans.total_score, ans.grading_status, p.last_heartbeat, ans.submit_time, CASE WHEN ans.status = '2' THEN CONCAT( '{"type":"grading","totalScore":', COALESCE(ans.total_score, 0), ',"details":', COALESCE(ans.grading_detail, '[]'), '}' ) ELSE p.progress_detail END AS progress_detail
mapper.select: SELECT FROM biz_guide_sheet_progress p INNER JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_id = p.student_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN biz_guide_sheet_answer ans ON ans.binding_id = p.binding_id AND ans.student_id = p.student_id WHERE p.binding_id = #{bindingId} ORDER BY p.dept_id, p.entry_year, p.class_code, s.student_no

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, b.binding_id, ans.answer_id, s.student_id, u.nick_name AS student_name, u.user_name AS student_user_name, s.student_no, la.dept_id, s.entry_year, s.class_code, COALESCE(p.current_page, ans.current_page, 0) AS current_page, COALESCE(p.is_submitted, IF(ans.status = '2', 'Y', 'N')) AS is_submitted, COALESCE(ans.status, '0') AS answer_status, ans.auto_score, COALESCE(ans.manual_adjustment, 0) AS manual_adjustment, ans.total_score, ans.grading_status, p.last_heartbeat, ans.submit_time, CASE WHEN ans.status = '2' THEN CONCAT( '{"type":"grading","totalScore":', COALESCE(ans.total_score, 0), ',"details":', COALESCE(ans.grading_detail, '[]'), '}' ) ELSE p.progress_detail END AS progress_detail FROM biz_lesson_guide_sheet_binding b INNER JOIN biz_lesson_assignment la ON la.lesson_id = b.lesson_id INNER JOIN biz_student s ON s.entry_year = la.entry_year AND s.class_code = la.class_code INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id AND u.dept_id = la.dept_id LEFT JOIN biz_guide_sheet_progress p ON p.binding_id = b.binding_id AND p.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN biz_guide_sheet_answer ans ON ans.binding_id = b.binding_id AND ans.student_id = s.student_id WHERE b.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND la.dept_id = #{deptId} AND la.entry_year = #{entryYear} AND la.class_code = #{classCode} ORDER BY s.student_no, s.student_id

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, b.binding_id, ans.answer_id, s.student_id, u.nick_name AS student_name, u.user_name AS student_user_name, s.student_no, la.dept_id, s.entry_year, s.class_code, COALESCE(p.current_page, ans.current_page, 0) AS current_page, COALESCE(p.is_submitted, IF(ans.status = '2', 'Y', 'N')) AS is_submitted, COALESCE(ans.status, '0') AS answer_status, ans.auto_score, COALESCE(ans.manual_adjustment, 0) AS manual_adjustment, ans.total_score, ans.grading_status, p.last_heartbeat, ans.submit_time, CASE WHEN ans.status = '2' THEN CONCAT( '{"type":"grading","totalScore":', COALESCE(ans.total_score, 0), ',"details":', COALESCE(ans.grading_detail, '[]'), '}' ) ELSE p.progress_detail END AS progress_detail FROM biz_lesson_guide_sheet_binding b INNER JOIN biz_lesson_assignment la ON la.lesson_id = b.lesson_id INNER JOIN biz_student s ON s.entry_year = la.entry_year AND s.class_code = la.class_code INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id AND u.dept_id = la.dept_id LEFT JOIN biz_guide_sheet_progress p ON p.binding_id = b.binding_id AND p.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN biz_guide_sheet_answer ans ON ans.binding_id = b.binding_id AND ans.student_id = s.student_id WHERE b.binding_id = #{bindingId} ORDER BY la.dept_id, la.entry_year, la.class_code, s.student_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_guide_sheet_progress ( binding_id, student_id, dept_id, entry_year, class_code, current_page, is_submitted, last_heartbeat, progress_detail ) VALUES ( #{bindingId}, #{studentId}, #{deptId}, #{entryYear}, #{classCode}, #{currentPage}, #{isSubmitted}, #{lastHeartbeat}, #{progressDetail} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_page = VALUES(current_page), is_submitted = IF(is_submitted = 'Y', 'Y', VALUES(is_submitted)), last_heartbeat = VALUES(last_heartbeat), progress_detail = COALESCE(VALUES(progress_detail), progress_detail)

INSERT INTO biz_guide_sheet_progress ( binding_id, student_id, dept_id, entry_year, class_code, current_page, is_submitted, last_heartbeat, progress_detail ) VALUES ( #{bindingId}, #{studentId}, #{deptId}, #{entryYear}, #{classCode}, 0, 'N', #{lastHeartbeat}, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_heartbeat = CASE WHEN last_heartbeat IS NULL OR last_heartbeat < VALUES(last_heartbeat) THEN VALUES(last_heartbeat) ELSE last_heartbeat END
